textbookBox.concept: Prevention is better than cure: concentrate when using machines, switch off power when idle, and never touch moving parts.

beats.en: Pesticides (insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, rodenticides) are toxic—wash skin immediately with soap and water if sprayed, and keep them away from people with asthma or allergies.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 10 physical-education · Safety Measures for Healthy Living · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: For electrical safety, use ISI-marked appliances, switch off power before and after use, avoid water near wires, and use dry sand (never water) on electrical fires.

beats.en: For electrical safety, use ISI-marked appliances, switch off power before and after use, avoid water near wires, and use dry sand (never water) on electrical fires.
beats.speakEn: For electrical safety, use ISI-marked appliances, switch off power before and after use, avoid water near wires, and use dry sand (never water) on electrical fires.

beats.en: First Aid is immediate care before medical help arrives. If a casualty is unconscious and not breathing, start CPR within 3 minutes to prevent brain damage (compressions + artificial breathing).
beats.speakEn: First Aid is immediate care before medical help arrives. If a casualty is unconscious and not breathing, start CPR within 3 minutes to prevent brain damage (compressions + artificial breathing).
